test_title: PYST 1: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 24 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered form 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '3'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e8923cfd81c614eb0d5f652b2ed4dda0bbdf868af96170e7eacd56fc5488c3d.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• It is an ordinary dice as the sum of right and left side is 7. 
 
• Since 4 and 6 are common in both dices, so opposite number of 3 is 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e8923cfd81c614eb0d5f652b2ed4dda0bbdf868af96170e7eacd56fc5488c3d.png] 

Hence, **1 **is opposite to the number 3.
